offering_description.value: Provides in-home respiratory care and medical equipment to patients with chronic conditions such as COPD and sleep apnea. Delivers ventilators, oxygen and sleep therapy equipment plus clinical support through its own branch locations. Bills Medicare, Medicaid and private insurers.

primary_products.value: home ventilators; sleep apnea therapy devices (CPAP/BiPAP); oxygen concentrators; respiratory supplies

primary_services.value: home respiratory therapy; durable medical equipment rental and setup; sleep therapy management; patient monitoring and clinical support

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with COPD, sleep apnea and other chronic respiratory conditions treated at home; B2B: physicians and private insurers referring and paying for patient care; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs as payers

end_markets.value: healthcare; home health; respiratory care; durable medical equipment

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: reimbursement from Medicare, Medicaid and private insurers for home respiratory care; rental or leasing: monthly rental of ventilators and other medical equipment to patients; product sales: sales of respiratory supplies and equipment
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment from device makers and delivers home respiratory care to patients; asset operator: owns and rents out medical equipment fleet through local branch locations

geography_served.value: US national: Operates in many US states, with concentration in the South such as Louisiana

specialization.value: related lines: respiratory equipment, ventilation, sleep therapy and related home care services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated branches serving local patients; direct sales: sales representatives calling on physicians and hospitals for referrals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement, CMS competitive bidding and billing rules, FDA device rules, state licensing

notes: Details of the current product mix and state coverage are from memory and may be partly outdated.
